accelerates_nonlinear_development.evidence: t_nl advances by 17.5-19.5% at 1e-5 and 45.8-47.3% at 1e-4 relative to 1e-6

changes_dominant_modes.evidence: dominant mode at 6T is m=4, m=6 and m=2 for amplitudes 1e-6, 1e-5 and 1e-4, respectively; aligned-time differences persist

reduces_symmetry_breaking.evidence: odd-mode fraction and mirror error fall by orders of magnitude at both enhanced amplitudes, although 1e-5 is not monotone from R48 to R96

improves_grid_consistency.evidence: 1e-4 R48/R96 peak and positive-integral differences are 4-8% at 2-10 mm except 1 mm at 18%; 1e-5 positive components remain 14-98% different at 1-5 mm

changes_transport_mechanism.answer: broad mechanism no; nonlinear pathway yes
changes_transport_mechanism.evidence: density-driven downward advection remains, but modal selection and nonlinear cascade change with amplitude

is_1e-5_worth_testing.evidence: it separates intermediate timing/symmetry behavior from the still grid-sensitive modal and positive-flux response

bounded_extension_recommendation.priority: extend all three 1e-5 grids together to at most 8T if positive-transport convergence is required
bounded_extension_recommendation.reason: no positive 10-mm advection by 6T and a 97.7% R48/R96 difference in the 5-mm positive integral
bounded_extension_recommendation.conditional_second_priority: extend all three 1e-4 grids to at most 8T only if an R24-inclusive deep-transport convergence claim is required

claim_boundary: not a replacement for 1e-6 and not validation of solubility-crossing time
